heroStrategy.headline: Create High-Quality AI Images & Videos with ByteDance Generative Models
heroStrategy.subheadline: Unlock the power of next-generation generative AI with Seedream 4.5 and Seedance 1.5 Pro for high-quality visual content creation.
heroStrategy.designNote: Use a premium editorial hero with a full-bleed dark mesh-gradient background, layered product mockups floating over a subtle grid, and an oversized left-aligned copy block embedded in the lower-left quadrant rather than a standard split layout. Keep the hero intentionally asymmetric: the main visual cluster should dominate the right and upper areas, while the headline sits in a clean text panel with orange CTA anchor. Add precision-line ornaments, soft orange orbs, and a proof strip directly below the fold. No autoplay video in hero; use a motion-preview card treatment with a play affordance to imply Seedance output while preserving a credible enterprise tone.

repetitionBreakers: Hero is dark split-screen and product-first, while trust switches to a light static logo grid for immediate credibility contrast.
Product section alternates between a tabs-with-preview image block and a split-panel video capability block to avoid repeated card-grid density.
Testimonials use a spotlight-led carousel feel to break the informational rhythm before pricing.
Pricing is treated as a centered comparison moment on a dark surface, then the lead form returns to a clean floating-card finish.
blueprint.pageTitle: Seedream 4.5 & Seedance 1.5 Pro | AI Image and Video Generation
blueprint.metaDescription: Create high-quality AI images and videos with ByteDance generative models. Explore Seedream 4.5 for image generation and Seedance 1.5 Pro for synchronized video creation for teams and enterprises.

sections.backgroundTreatment: subtle precision-line grid with dark layered panels and orange highlight accents
sections.designNote: Content-first hero that directly answers what it is, who it is for, and what to do next. Use a premium dark editorial split with the headline and CTA on the left and a layered product visual on the right showing image and video generation chips. Keep the copy aligned to the ad message for warm-traffic continuity. Primary CTA is 'Get started' in solid orange at 100% opacity, full-width on mobile.

Immediate credibility band directly under the hero using 3-6 recognizable enterprise/customer logos in a clean flex-wrap grid. Keep it quiet, white/light, and compact so the next section can shift into darker educational depth. If logos are unavailable or weak, replace with a slim metric strip.

Use the first product block as a visual-first tabs-with-preview section focused on Seedream 4.5, because it has 5+ features and needs structured exploration. Lead with the most click-relevant capabilities: text-to-image, high resolution, text rendering, and multi-image composition. Then alternate into a split-panel or accordion-style block for Seedance 1.5 Pro to emphasize video and audio synchronization. Keep the section dense but readable, with no static flat grid for the feature set. This section should feel like the 'how it works' plus product capability moment for warm traffic.

Three-step process section under 60 seconds: 1) enter prompt, upload image, or script, 2) generate or refine with Seedream or Seedance, 3) export and use visuals in campaigns, ads, or content pipelines. Use a light background and compact numbered steps with one strong illustration strip to reset the reading tempo after the darker product block. This section should be concise and confidence-building rather than explanatory-heavy.

Secondary proof moment in a dark band to reinforce enterprise credibility after the process explanation. Use the same 3-6 recognisable logos if available, but present them larger and more elevated than the opening trust strip. If logos are weak, convert this into a slim metrics band with adoption, speed, or creative-output claims.

Do not use a generic feature grid. Spotlight the 1-2 most conversion-relevant features that drove the click: Seedream 4.5 for high-fidelity image generation and Seedance 1.5 Pro for synchronized audio-visual video creation. Use a large editorial spotlight card for each, with supporting proof bullets beneath. This section should read like a refined capability showcase rather than a catalog.

Use a 4+ testimonial carousel or spotlight row because enough testimonials exist. Keep the presentation dark and premium, with larger quote pulls from creative and marketing roles to emphasize speed, fidelity, and storytelling. This section should interrupt the utility rhythm with human proof before the conversion close.

Present pricing as a focused decision point rather than a comparison table. Highlight Seedance 1.5 Pro pricing and keep Seedream 4.5 as a companion plan card. Use one primary CTA label only: 'Get started'. Keep the layout compact and decisive, with the orange accent as the only button color.

Final conversion block with a floating centered card over a dark premium surface. Keep it short, high-contrast, and friction-light. This is the last CTA moment and should visually feel more urgent than the pricing section. On mobile, the CTA must be full-width and solid orange.

blueprint.designPersonality: An intelligent, editorial B2B AI showcase with strong brand-orange accents, dark premium surfaces, and trust-led structure. The page should feel enterprise-ready, visually polished, and product-dense without becoming cluttered. Logos should dominate the trust story, followed by clear capability sections, a dark video gallery, and a high-conversion CTA strip.
blueprint.imageryDirection: Use a dark editorial hero with layered product mockups, floating chips for image generation and video generation, and a strong proof bar of enterprise logos immediately beneath the hero. Include a dedicated dark video gallery section with thumbnail cards, playback-style overlays, and motion-safe preview frames that imply Seedance 1.5 Pro output. The imagery should feel like a premium AI studio, not a consumer app.

designStrategy.reasoning: This page is best treated as a lead-generation landing page for solution-aware buyers who already understand generative AI and need confidence, clarity, and proof before requesting a demo or quote. Because the audience is professionals and enterprises, the page should feel premium and efficient rather than playful. Trust should be dominated by logos, since the brief explicitly says visitors trust logos most. The narrative should be product-led: establish the combined value of Seedream 4.5 and Seedance 1.5 Pro, then unpack capabilities, then convert through form, pricing, testimonials, and footer. A centered hero works best with a dark theme because the page needs a strong cinematic AI feel while keeping the content readable and avoiding a split layout that could create empty space. The design should remain balanced and vertically structured, with a clear video gallery section to support Seedance's motion-first value. Conversion is high priority, so the CTA should be visible but not overly aggressive, with the form acting as the main close mechanism.
